title: One compacted batch of module summaries
description: An intermediate pass, so a repository with more summaries than fit in one context window still reaches synthesis. Every field synthesize-modules.md reads is carried, in the shape analyze-module-out.json defines it, because a batch record and a module summary end up side by side in the final payload. `public_api` is the one field synthesis never reads and the bulk of a summary's size, so it is what compaction sheds.

data_flow.description: What comes in and what goes out. The key-flows section traces its paths from these.

gotchas.description: Kept whole, in analyze-module-out.json's shape, with the file and line still attached.

onboarding_priority.description: Carried verbatim. The reading-order section is told to work from it, so a batch that drops it reorders the guide silently.
